'''White Squadron''' was a [[New Jedi Order]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] active in [[44 ABY]]. It contained at least one unknown [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], which was unsuited for combat purposes.

==History==
White Squadron participated in a [[Operation Shieldfall|battle]] on [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] in a supporting role. [[Taryn Zel]] wished to rescue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Raynar Thul]] after he was shot down by a [[Golan III Space Defense NovaGun]]. She was told by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyle Katarn]] that her shuttle was unsuitable for combat retrieval.
